content: The composite Malfunction Indicator Lamp shall be set to Lamp Off in case the Indicator referenced by DemMILIndicatorRef has an IndicatorStatus DEM_INDICATOR_OFF . All other IndicatorStatus states than DEM_INDICATOR_OFF shall set the composite Malfunction Indicator Lamp to Lamp On.

The composite Malfunction Indicator Lamp shall be set to Lamp Off in case the Indicator referenced by DemMILIndicatorRef has an IndicatorStatus DEM_INDICATOR_OFF . All other IndicatorStatus states than DEM_INDICATOR_OFF shall set the composite Malfunction Indicator Lamp to Lamp On.

The composite Malfunction Indicator Lamp shall be set to Lamp Off in case the Indicator referenced by DemMILIndicatorRef has an IndicatorStatus DEM_INDICATOR_OFF . All other IndicatorStatus states than DEM_INDICATOR_OFF shall set the composite Malfunction Indicator Lamp to Lamp On.
